description: What changed in hospital prices this week? Colorado hospital price, payer-rate, file and status change records, computed by Distill by diffing the hospitals’ price-transparency files. Change records from diffing consecutive weekly builds: a hospital republishing its file (source raw_sha256), items and payer rates that appear, disappear or change price, a hospital’s status or file date changing, and the canonical payer of a payer/plan name changing. Keys: source `<source_id>`; hospital `<hospital id>`; item `<source_id>|<type>|<code>|<setting>|<billing_class>|<modifiers>`; rate `<item key>|<payer name>|<plan name>|<methodology>` (names as the hospital writes them; one rate per methodology, empty when none is given); plan `<payer name>|<plan name>`. Money is integer micro-USD (unit usd_micro). Each record cites the sha256 of the file versions it came from. Pages of up to 100, oldest first; pass next_cursor back as cursor. Updated weekly. Price: $0.05 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Change records are diffs of consecutive serving DBs, computed deterministically; confidence is the feed’s freshness only: 1 within 14 days of the newest build, then halving every 30 days. Posted standard charges from hospital machine-readable files (45 CFR 180): posted rates, not a quote; not medical or financial advice. What you pay depends on your plan, your care and the hospital. See /terms.

since.description: Only records detected at or after this time (ISO 8601).
